correctness.rationale: All quantifiers and the convention on empty maps are explicit. Fixing image root sets gives the occupancy formula; an independent coefficient extraction proves the same count. The random rank law follows from hypergeometric overlaps and bounded-difference occupancy concentration. Explicit enumeration checks n<=5 (299755 ordered pairs) and two formulas agree for n<=14 (5440 rank triples). Finiteness of computation is not used as an all-size proof.

value.rationale: The entire natural four-parameter product-rank distribution of pairs of arbitrary partial idempotents is determined; in contrast to simple support or single-idempotent counts it distinguishes 0-domain effects and all noncommuting products. Its explicit law of large numbers demonstrates a strict macroscopic order asymmetry, providing a motivated structural statistic and limiting prediction, rather than arbitrary finite tabulation.
